questions.stem_text: Which situation could be represented by the expression 6 x 2?

options.A: Rocco read six books in two months.
options.B: Rocco hiked six miles each day for two days.
options.C: Rocco spent six hours on homework for two days.
options.D: Rocco has six siblings and two of them are girls.
options.E: Rocco had a total of six tennis balls in two cans.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Rocco hiked six miles each day for two days.

How many two-digit prime numbers have a units digit of 7?
questions.gold_answer:
The tens digit cannot be 2, 5, or 8 because otherwise, the sum of the digits, and thus the
number itself, is divisible by 3. The remaining possibilities are 17, 37, 47, 67, 77, and
97. Only $77=7\cdot 11$ is composite, so there are $\boxed{5}$ two-digit prime numbers
that have a units digit of 7.

questions.stem_text:
How many paths are there from $A$ to $B$ on the lines of the grid shown, if every step
must be up or to the right?[asy]size(3 cm,3 cm);int w=6;int h=3;int i;for (i=0; i<h; ++i){
draw((0,i) -- (w-1,i));}for (i=0; i<w; ++i){ draw((i, 0)--(i,h-1));}label("$B$",
(w-1,h-1), NE);label("$A$", (0,0), SW);[/asy] For example, here is one such valid path
highlighted in blue: [asy] size(3 cm,3 cm); int w=6; int h=3; int i; for (i=0; i<h; ++i){
draw((0,i) -- (w-1,i)); }for (i=0; i<w; ++i){ draw((i, 0)--(i,h-1)); } label("$B$",
(w-1,h-1), NE); label("$A$", (0,0), SW); draw((0,0)--(1,0), blue+1.5); draw((1,0)--(1,1),
blue+1.5); draw((1,1)--(2,1), blue+1.5); draw((2,1)--(3,1), blue+1.5); draw((3,1)--(4,1),
blue+1.5); draw((4,1)--(4,2), blue+1.5); draw((4,2)--(5,2), blue+1.5); [/asy]
questions.gold_answer:
There are 5 steps to the right, and 2 steps up. These 7 steps can be made in any order, so
the answer is $\dbinom{7}{2} = \dfrac{7 \times 6}{2 \times 1} = \boxed{21}$.
